### **Description and Requirements**

* Administer ADA (Americans with Disability Act) standalone claims


* Complete eligibility decisions and review for entitlement, gather pertinent data when necessary, from employee, physicians office or employer through outgoing calls, email, fax or other supporting systems.


* Promptly review new ADA, evaluate against appropriate leave plans and make initial claim decision.


* Perform leave administration tasks as required, including recertification of health condition, intermittent claim tracking, RTW confirmation, return phone calls, etc.


* Update systems to accurately reflect leave status and ensure appropriate diary documentation exists


* Business recommended TAT to complete the activity is up to 5 business days to maintain compliance measures


* The position is expected to do absence management and adjudication on Federal, State and company leaves.


* Interact with claim specialist, claim support specialist, QA, Claims Unit Leader (stateside supervisors), employees, employers/customer and physician’s office

  

  

**About MetLife**  

Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies" and Fortune World’s 25 Best Workplaces™, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world’s leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. With operations in more than 40 markets, we hold leading positions in the United States, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East.  

As part of our New Frontier strategy, MetLife is building an AI\-enabled, people\-centered future. We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset as we use AI to enhance how we serve customers, support communities, and evolve the way work gets done. At MetLife, AI is a responsible partner that supports human judgment, creativity, and continuous improvement while helping us build trust, inclusion, and long\-term value.  

Our purpose is simple \- to help our colleagues, customers, communities, and the world at large create a more confident future. United by purpose and guided by our core values \- Win Together, Do the Right Thing, Deliver Impact Over Activity, and Think Ahead \- we’re inspired to transform the next century in financial services. At MetLife, it’s \#AllTogetherPossible. Join us!

description:
**Head of Operations – Intercity \& Smart Bus Services**

We are looking for a high\-velocity, data\-driven **Head of Operations** to scale and manage our tech\-enabled smart bus network.

* **Supply \& Vendor Management:** Onboard, manage, and retain private bus operators and asset owners. Build sustainable partnership frameworks, resolve merchant queries, and establish seamless payout tracking structures.
* **On\-Ground Execution \& Hub Operations:** Oversee terminal operations, boarding lounges, smart hubs, and pitstops. Ensure highly efficient dispatch, on\-time departures, and seamless terminal management.
* **Service Level Agreements (SLAs) \& Quality Assurance:** Define and maintain rigorous standards for vehicle cleanliness, driver/crew behavioral training, onboard amenities (Wi\-Fi, charging points), and passenger safety.
* **Fleet Optimization \& Yield:** Collaborate with the product and revenue teams to maximize bus utilization, track route performance metrics, optimize vehicle routing layouts, and control operational costs.
* **Incident Management \& Crisis Control:** Build 24/7 command center matrices for breakdown responses, alternative fleet deployment, customer safety incidents, and real\-time transit disruption management.
* **Team Leadership:** Build and manage cross\-functional teams including Regional Operations Managers, Ground Operations Executives, Support Agents, and Route Auditors.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Experience:** **8–12 years** of core operations experience, with at least **3\+ years** in a leadership capacity at a prominent intercity bus aggregator, smart mobility platform, micro\-mobility startup, or tech\-first fleet operator.
* **Tech\-Savvy Mindset:** Deep comfort using and optimizing digital telemetry tools, internal automated dashboard platforms, route\-mapping software, and fleet tracking SaaS.
* **Analytical Prowess:** Strong ability to manipulate data dashboards to identify supply gaps, bottleneck trends, operational leakages, and route\-level P\&L opportunities.
* **Hands\-on Approach:** A leader who loves getting onto the field, auditing boarding points directly, and interacting directly with drivers and suppliers to streamline ground ops.
* **Communication:** Exceptional negotiation skills to handle tough conversations with traditional bus operators, alongside polished leadership skills to present data metrics to the C\-suite.

Pay: ₹2,000,000\.00 \- ₹3,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Production Manager
description:
**Company:** Aadvay Manufacturing Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:** Lal Kuan, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh

**Salary:** Up to ₹45,000 per month

**Experience:** 3–7 Years

**Industry:** CCTV / Electronics Manufacturing

**Job Summary**

Aadvay Manufacturing Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced **CCTV Camera Production Manager** to oversee the complete production process of CCTV cameras, ensuring smooth operations, quality standards, timely production, and efficient utilization of manpower and resources.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan, manage, and monitor daily CCTV camera production activities.
* Supervise production staff, technicians, assemblers, and operators.
* Ensure production targets are achieved within the planned timelines.
* Manage production planning, manpower allocation, and shift schedules.
* Monitor the assembly, testing, soldering, and packaging processes.
* Ensure CCTV cameras meet defined quality and performance standards.
* Coordinate with **Purchase, Quality, Stores, R\&D, and Dispatch** teams.
* Identify production bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.
* Monitor rejection, rework, wastage, and production efficiency.
* Maintain production records, reports, and daily MIS.
* Implement and maintain workplace safety and 5S practices.
* Troubleshoot production\-related issues and coordinate with technical teams.
* Continuously improve production processes to reduce cost and minimize wastage.

**Requirements**

* 3–7 years of experience in **CCTV, electronics, LED, PCB, or similar manufacturing**.
* Strong knowledge of CCTV camera assembly and production processes.
* Experience in handling production teams and achieving daily targets.
* Good understanding of PCB, electronic components, soldering, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Strong leadership, problem\-solving, and team\-management skills.
* Ability to work under production deadlines and manage multiple activities efficiently.

**Key Skills**

**Production Planning \| Team Management \| CCTV Assembly \| Electronics Manufacturing \| Quality Control \| PCB Knowledge \| Production MIS \| Inventory Coordination \| Process Improvement \| Manpower Management**

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Production Manager
description:
**About ISIEINDIA**

ISIEINDIA Pvt. Ltd. works in the fields of Electric Vehicles (EV), Solar Energy, Renewable Energy, and emerging technologies. We focus on practical skill development, technical training, innovation, and industry\-oriented solutions. Our EV workbenches and laboratory setups are designed to provide hands\-on learning and practical exposure to students and professionals.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Production Manager – EV Workbenches** to manage day\-to\-day operations related to the manufacturing, assembly, testing, and delivery of EV workbenches and laboratory setups. The candidate will be responsible for manpower handling, workforce planning, PPC (Production Planning \& Control), process coordination, documentation, and ensuring smooth execution of operations within defined timelines and quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and oversee day\-to\-day operational activities related to EV workbench production and project execution.
* Plan and allocate **manpower and workforce** based on production requirements and project timelines.
* Prepare and monitor **PPC plans** to ensure timely completion of production activities.
* Coordinate with production, purchase, stores, design, and other internal teams for smooth operations.
* Monitor daily production progress, workforce utilization, and project timelines.
* Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, tools, equipment, and other resources.
* Handle workforce deployment, attendance, productivity, and daily work allocation.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and coordinate with relevant teams for timely resolution.
* Maintain proper **production and operational documentation**, records, reports, and trackers.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly production/operations reports and share progress updates with management.
* Ensure proper documentation of work orders, production schedules, material requirements, inspection records, and dispatch details.
* Monitor work processes to ensure adherence to quality, safety, and operational standards.
* Coordinate for installation and commissioning activities at client locations whenever required.
* Track project requirements and ensure timely execution and closure of assigned activities.
* Support management in improving operational processes, productivity, and workforce efficiency.

**Required Qualification**

* B.Tech/B.E. in **Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Automobile, or related Engineering discipline**.
* **3\+ years of experience** in operations, production, manufacturing, project execution, or workforce management.
* Experience in **manpower handling, workforce planning, PPC, and operational coordination**.
* Strong knowledge of production processes, assembly, electrical wiring, fabrication, and testing.
* Good understanding of **production planning, resource allocation, and workflow management**.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and other documentation/reporting tools.
* Good communication, coordination, leadership, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and operational activities simultaneously.
* Knowledge of **EV components, EV workbenches, automotive systems, or laboratory equipment** will be an added advantage.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Production Manager
description:
Production Manager – Plush Toy Manufacturing

**Location:** Noida  
**Experience:** 5\+ Years  
**Industry:** Plush Toys / Soft Toys / Toy Manufacturing

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Production Manager** to manage and oversee end\-to\-end production operations at our Plush Toy Manufacturing Unit. The ideal candidate will be responsible for production planning, manpower management, quality, productivity, and timely achievement of production targets.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end\-to\-end production operations and ensure timely achievement of daily and monthly targets.
* Prepare production schedules based on orders, manpower, materials, and production capacity.
* Manage production teams, supervisors, operators, and manpower efficiently.
* Oversee cutting, stitching, stuffing, finishing, and packing processes.
* Monitor productivity, quality, wastage, rework, and production costs.
* Coordinate with Purchase, Stores, Quality, Design, and Dispatch teams.
* Identify production bottlenecks and implement process improvements.
* Ensure adherence to quality, safety, and shop\-floor standards.
* Maintain production reports, MIS, and other operational records.

Requirements

* Minimum **5 years of experience** in production/manufacturing operations.
* Experience in **Plush Toys, Soft Toys, Garments, Textiles, or similar manufacturing industries** will be preferred.
* Strong knowledge of production planning and manpower management.
* Excellent leadership, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Good working knowledge of **MS Excel and Production MIS**.
* Ability to manage production targets, timelines, and shop\-floor operations effectively.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
